newsitem.title: USA: PathoGenisis gets expedited review of TOBI.
newsitem.headline: PathoGenisis gets expedited review of TOBI.

text.p: PathoGenesis Corp said on Tuesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has agreed to an expedited review of the new drug application that the company plans to submit for its lead drug candidate, TOBI (tobramycin for inhalation) for treating chronic pseudomonal lung infections in people with cystic fibrosis.
PathoGenesis said it intends to submit this new drug application in the second quarter of 1997.

The FDA informed PathoGenesis that in order to facilitate an expedited review, the company may pre-submit chemistry, stability and other non-clinical data as addenda to its previously filed investigational new drug application.
